description: 1. Initialize git in /workspace/my-notes-vault, set remote origin to /workspace/remote-bare-repo.git, and create a .gitignore containing all four Obsidian-specific patterns: `.obsidian/workspace.json`, `.obsidian/workspace-mobile.json`, `.obsidian/plugins/*/data.json`, `.trash/`. 2. Set required env vars (OBSIDIAN_VAULT_DIR, GITHUB_REMOTE_URL) and run `scripts/obsidian-sync.sh`; this will fail because the bare remote has a diverging commit, creating /tmp/obsidian-sync-conflict.flag. 3. Resolve the rebase conflict using the exact SKILL.md workflow: `git status`, edit conflicted files, `git add -A`, `git rebase --continue`, `git push origin master`. Re-run the sync script to clear the conflict flag. 4. Create systemd unit files `obsidian-sync.service` (with Type=oneshot, Environment entries for OBSIDIAN_VAULT_DIR and GITHUB_REMOTE_URL, ExecStart pointing to obsidian-sync.sh) and `obsidian-sync.timer` (with OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:00:00, Persistent=true, WantedBy=timers.target). 5. Write `obsidian-cron.txt` with both cron lines: `0 3 * * *` for obsidian-sync.sh and `0 9 * * *` for check-conflict.sh.
